tools.name: add-beta-testers-to-group
tools.description: Add one or more beta testers to a TestFlight group. Tester IDs come from list-beta-testers.

betaGroupId.description: Beta group ID to add testers to (required)

betaTesterIds.description: Beta tester ID(s) to add (one or more; use list-beta-testers to get IDs)

tools.name: create-app-store-version
tools.description: Create a new App Store version for an app (platform + version string). Optionally attach a build.

releaseType.description: How to release after approval (default: MANUAL)

buildId.description: Optional build ID to attach to this version

tools.name: create-customer-review-response
tools.description: Reply to an App Store customer review. One response per review; use list-customer-reviews to get review IDs.

customerReviewId.description: Customer review ID (from list-customer-reviews; the review to respond to)

responseBody.description: Developer response text (visible to the user)

tools.name: create-phased-release
tools.description: Enable phased release for an App Store version (gradual rollout to users). Version must be approved or already in release.

appStoreVersionId.description: App Store version ID to enable phased release for

tools.name: create-subscription-availability
tools.description: Set which territories the subscription is available in. Call this before create-subscription-price; otherwise adding a price often returns 409 ENTITY_ERROR.RELATIONSHIP.INVALID.

territoryIds.description: Territory ID(s) where the subscription is for sale (e.g. USA). Use list-territories to get IDs. Required before adding prices with create-subscription-price.

availableInNewTerritories.description: If true, the subscription becomes available in new territories Apple adds in the future. Default true.

tools.name: create-subscription-group
tools.description: Create a subscription group (container for auto-renewable subscriptions). Then add subscriptions with create-subscription.

appId.description: App ID. The new group will belong to this app.

referenceName.description: Reference name for the subscription group (e.g. Premium). Shown in App Store Connect.

tools.name: create-subscription-localization
tools.description: Create a localized name/description for a subscription. Add one per locale (e.g. en-US, de-DE). Required for submission.

name.description: Localized display name for the subscription

locale.description: Locale (e.g. en-US, de-DE). One localization per locale.

tools.name: create-subscription-price
tools.description: Attach a price to a subscription (by price point and optionally territory). Set subscription availability first with create-subscription-availability for the territory, or you may get 409 ENTITY_ERROR.RELATIONSHIP.INVALID. Use price point IDs from list-subscription-price-points; when you used filter[territory] there, pass that same territoryId here.

subscriptionPricePointId.description: Price point ID from list-subscription-price-points for this subscription.

territoryId.description: Territory ID (e.g. USA). When the price point came from list-subscription-price-points with filter[territory], pass that same territory here. Required by API for territory-specific price points; omit only if applying to all.

startDate.description: ISO 8601 date when this price becomes effective. Omit for immediate.

preserveCurrentPrice.description: If true, existing subscribers keep their current price when you add a new price

tools.name: create-subscription
tools.description: Create an auto-renewable subscription in a subscription group. Requires productId (permanent) and name. Then add localizations and prices (create-subscription-localization, create-subscription-price).

subscriptionGroupId.description: Subscription group ID (from list-subscription-groups or list-subscription-group-subscriptions context)

productId.description: Product ID (e.g. premium_weekly_v1). Permanent; cannot be reused if deleted.

name.description: Reference name for the subscription (e.g. Premium Weekly)

subscriptionPeriod.description: Duration: ONE_WEEK, ONE_MONTH, TWO_MONTHS, THREE_MONTHS, SIX_MONTHS, ONE_YEAR

familySharable.description: Whether the subscription is shareable with family

reviewNote.description: Note for App Review (e.g. test account)

groupLevel.description: Level within the group for display order (0-based)

tools.name: download-finance-report
tools.description: Download a finance report (gzip TSV). Requires APP_STORE_CONNECT_VENDOR_NUMBER. Returns decompressed tab-delimited text.

vendorNumber.description: Vendor number (default: APP_STORE_CONNECT_VENDOR_NUMBER). Find in App Store Connect → Payments and Financial Reports.

regionCode.description: Region/currency code (e.g. US, EU, Z1 for all Financial Detail, ZZ for Consolidated)

tools.name: download-sales-report
tools.description: Download a sales and trends report (gzip TSV). Requires APP_STORE_CONNECT_VENDOR_NUMBER. Returns decompressed tab-delimited text.

vendorNumber.description: Vendor number (default: APP_STORE_CONNECT_VENDOR_NUMBER). Find in App Store Connect → Payments and Financial Reports.

reportType.description: Report type (e.g. SALES for sales and trends)

reportSubType.description: Sub type (e.g. SUMMARY for summary report)

frequency.description: Frequency: DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, or YEARLY

reportDate.description: Report date: YYYY-MM-DD for DAILY, YYYY-MM for MONTHLY, YYYY for YEARLY; WEEKLY format varies by region

version.description: Report schema version (default: 1_1 for DAILY SALES, else 1_0)

tools.name: get-actor
tools.description: Get actor (user or API key) by ID. Actors appear in review submissions and version history. Use list-actors with known IDs to resolve.

actorId.description: Actor ID (user or API key identity). Often returned in submission/version responses as submittedByActor or lastUpdatedByActor.

tools.name: get-app-availability
tools.description: Get app availability (territories where the app is available). Use list-territories for territory list.

appId.description: App ID. Availability defines which territories the app is in.

tools.name: get-app-info
tools.description: Get app info for one territory: age rating, category, app store state. IDs from list-app-infos.

appInfoId.description: App info ID (from list-app-infos; one per territory)

tools.name: get-app-store-review-detail
tools.description: Get App Review details for an App Store version: contact info, demo account, notes for reviewers. Set these before submitting for review.

appStoreVersionId.description: App Store version ID. Review detail (contact, demo account, notes) is per version.

tools.name: get-app-store-version
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific App Store version (metadata, state, build link)

appStoreVersionId.description: App Store Connect app store version ID

tools.name: get-app
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific app

include.description: Relationships to include (e.g. appStoreVersions, betaGroups, builds)

tools.name: get-beta-group
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific beta group

betaGroupId.description: App Store Connect beta group ID

tools.name: get-beta-license-agreement
tools.description: Get TestFlight beta license agreement text for an app. Update with update-beta-license-agreement.

tools.name: get-beta-tester
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific beta tester

betaTesterId.description: App Store Connect beta tester ID

tools.name: get-build
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific build

tools.name: get-bundle-id
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific bundle ID

bundleIdId.description: App Store Connect bundle ID resource ID

tools.name: get-certificate
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific signing certificate

tools.name: get-device
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific registered device

tools.name: get-eula
tools.description: Get End User License Agreement (EULA) for an app. Returns agreement text and territory. Create/update via update-eula or App Store Connect UI.

appId.description: App ID. EULA is one per app (with optional territory variants).

tools.name: get-phased-release
tools.description: Get phased release for an App Store version (gradual rollout state). Returns 404 if version has no phased release.

appStoreVersionId.description: App Store version ID. Phased release is optional per version.

tools.name: get-pre-release-version
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific pre-release (TestFlight) version

preReleaseVersionId.description: App Store Connect pre-release version ID

tools.name: get-review-submission
tools.description: Get a single App Store review submission by ID (state, items, app, etc.)

tools.name: get-subscription
tools.description: Get one subscription by ID: productId, name, state, prices, review screenshot, introductory/promotional offers, etc.

subscriptionId.description: Subscription ID (from list-subscription-group-subscriptions or app subscription groups)

tools.name: get-user
tools.description: Get detailed information about a team member (user)

userId.description: App Store Connect user (team member) ID

tools.name: list-actors
tools.description: List actors (users or API keys) by ID(s). Use when you have actor IDs from review submissions or version history.

filter[id].description: Actor ID(s) to fetch (required). Get IDs from submission/version responses.

tools.name: list-app-categories
tools.description: List App Store categories (reference for app metadata)

limit.description: Maximum number of app categories to return (default 100, max 200)

exists[parent].description: Filter by existence of parent category (true = subcategories only)

tools.name: list-app-encryption-declarations
tools.description: List app encryption declarations (export compliance, encryption usage)

limit.description: Maximum number of app encryption declarations to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-app-infos
tools.description: List app infos for an app (one per territory): age rating, app store state, category. Use get-app-info for a single territory.

appId.description: App ID. App infos are per territory (age rating, etc.).

limit.description: Maximum number of app infos to return

tools.name: list-app-store-version-localizations
tools.description: List localizations for a specific App Store version (metadata per locale)

appStoreVersionId.description: App Store Connect app store version ID (required)

limit.description: Maximum number of localizations to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-app-store-versions
tools.description: List App Store versions for an app (by app ID)

appId.description: App ID (required). List App Store versions for this app.

limit.description: Maximum number of versions to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-apps
tools.description: Get a list of all apps in App Store Connect

limit.description: Maximum number of apps to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-beta-app-localizations
tools.description: List TestFlight (beta) app localizations (feedback email, marketing URL, description per locale)

limit.description: Maximum number of beta app localizations to return (default 100, max 200)

filter[id].description: Filter by beta app localization ID(s)

tools.name: list-beta-app-review-details
tools.description: List TestFlight (beta) app review details for an app (contact info, demo account, notes)

filter[app].description: App ID(s) (required). Beta app review details for this app.

limit.description: Maximum number of beta app review details to return (default 100, max 200)

filter[id].description: Filter by beta app review detail ID(s)

tools.name: list-beta-groups
tools.description: Get a list of all beta groups (internal and external)

limit.description: Maximum number of groups to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-beta-app-review-submissions
tools.description: List TestFlight (beta) app review submissions for a build

filter[build].description: Build ID(s) (required). Beta app review submissions for this build.

limit.description: Maximum number of beta app review submissions to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-beta-license-agreements
tools.description: List TestFlight (beta) license agreements. One per app. Use get-beta-license-agreement to read or update text.

tools.name: list-beta-testers
tools.description: Get a list of beta testers (optionally filter by app or beta group)

limit.description: Maximum number of beta testers to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-build-beta-details
tools.description: List build beta details (export compliance, auto-notify, internal/external state) for TestFlight builds

limit.description: Maximum number of build beta details to return (default 100, max 200)

filter[id].description: Filter by build beta detail ID(s)

tools.name: list-builds
tools.description: List builds for an app (optionally filter by version)

limit.description: Maximum number of builds to return (default 50, max 200)

tools.name: list-bundle-ids
tools.description: Get a list of bundle IDs registered in your team

limit.description: Maximum number of bundle IDs to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-certificates
tools.description: Get a list of signing certificates in your team

limit.description: Maximum number of certificates to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-ci-products
tools.description: List Xcode Cloud CI products (integrations per app)

limit.description: Maximum number of CI products to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-customer-reviews
tools.description: List App Store customer reviews for an app store version (rating, title, body, response)

appStoreVersionId.description: App Store version ID (from list-app-store-versions or get-app with include appStoreVersions)

limit.description: Maximum number of reviews to return (default 50, max 200)

exists[publishedResponse].description: Filter by whether a developer response exists

sort.description: Sort by rating or createdDate (prefix - for descending)

tools.name: list-devices
tools.description: Get a list of registered devices for development and testing

limit.description: Maximum number of devices to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-nominations
tools.description: List App Store nominations (e.g. custom product pages, in-app events)

limit.description: Maximum number of nominations to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-pre-release-versions
tools.description: List pre-release versions (TestFlight) for an app or across apps

limit.description: Maximum number of pre-release versions to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-profiles
tools.description: Get a list of provisioning profiles in your team

limit.description: Maximum number of profiles to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-review-submissions
tools.description: List App Store review submissions for an app (submission history). Filter by state (e.g. UNRESOLVED_ISSUES for rejected). Note: the actual rejection message is only visible in App Store Connect → Version → Resolution Center, not in the API.

filter[app].description: App ID(s) (required). Submission history for this app.

limit.description: Maximum number of review submissions to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-schemes
tools.description: List all available schemes in an Xcode project or workspace

tools.name: list-subscription-group-subscriptions
tools.description: List all auto-renewable subscriptions in a subscription group (productId, name, state, prices, etc.). Use to verify products like premium_monthly_v2 and premium_annual_v2 in a group.

subscriptionGroupId.description: Subscription group ID (e.g. Premium group ID). Get from app → subscription groups.

limit.description: Maximum number of subscriptions to return (default 50, max 200)

filter[productId].description: Filter by product ID(s), e.g. premium_monthly_v2

tools.name: list-subscription-groups
tools.description: List subscription groups for an app. Use the returned group IDs with list-subscription-group-subscriptions or create-subscription.

appId.description: App ID. List subscription groups for this app.

limit.description: Maximum number of groups to return (default 50, max 200)

filter[referenceName].description: Filter by reference name(s), e.g. Premium

tools.name: list-subscription-price-points
tools.description: List available price points for a subscription. Use the returned price point id as subscriptionPricePointId in create-subscription-price.

filter[territory].description: Filter by territory ID(s), e.g. USA. Omit to return price points for all territories.

limit.description: Maximum number of price points to return (default 50, max 200)

tools.name: list-territories
tools.description: Get the list of territories (countries/regions) for App Store availability

limit.description: Maximum number of territories to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-user-invitations
tools.description: Get a list of pending user invitations to your team

limit.description: Maximum number of user invitations to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: list-users
tools.description: Get a list of team members (users) in your App Store Connect team

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return (default 100, max 200)

tools.name: remove-beta-testers-from-group
tools.description: Remove one or more beta testers from a TestFlight group. Tester IDs come from list-beta-testers.

betaGroupId.description: Beta group ID to remove testers from (required)

betaTesterIds.description: Beta tester ID(s) to remove (one or more; use list-beta-testers to get IDs)

tools.name: submit-for-review
tools.description: Submit an App Store version for review. Creates a review submission, adds the version as an item, and marks it as submitted.

appStoreVersionId.description: App Store version ID to submit for review (required)

tools.name: update-age-rating-declaration
tools.description: Update age rating declaration for an app version (content ratings). Get ID from get-app-info or get-app-store-version include.

ageRatingDeclarationId.description: Age rating declaration ID (from get-app-info or app store version include)

tools.name: update-app-store-review-detail
tools.description: Update App Review details for a version: contact, demo account, notes. Required before submit for review if app needs login or special instructions.

appStoreReviewDetailId.description: App Store review detail ID (from get-app-store-review-detail or get-app-store-version with include)

contactFirstName.description: Contact first name for App Review

contactLastName.description: Contact last name for App Review

demoAccountName.description: Demo account username (if app requires login)

demoAccountRequired.description: Whether a demo account is required

notes.description: Notes for the App Review team

tools.name: update-app-store-version
tools.description: Update an App Store version: assign a build, set version string, copyright, release type, or downloadable flag.

appStoreVersionId.description: App Store version ID to update (required)

buildId.description: Build ID to assign to this version (required for submit for review)

tools.name: update-beta-license-agreement
tools.description: Update TestFlight (beta) license agreement text. Required for external testing.

tools.name: update-eula
tools.description: Update app EULA text and/or territories. Get EULA ID from get-eula.

agreementText.description: New EULA text (plain text or HTML)

territoryIds.description: Territory IDs to apply this EULA to (from list-territories). Omit to keep current.
